Package library

Class Member

java.lang.Object
library.user
library.Member
public class Member extends user
Represents a non-admin library user who can borrow books and CDs, accumulate fines, and manage multiple types of loans.

This class extends user and adds member-specific attributes such as email, fine balance, traditional book loans (loan), and polymorphic media loans (MediaLoan) introduced in Sprint 5.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Manage personal loan history
  • Track fines and payments
  • Control borrowing permissions
  • Support polymorphic media loaning

      public boolean canBorrow()
      Determines whether the member is allowed to borrow new media. Borrowing is blocked if:

      true if borrowing is allowed, otherwise false
